## No matter your CAD and PLM setup, CoLab is prepared to take your design reviews to the next level.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/660aa7febec017e773b39201/663101efbd1a3931cb8773f8_Vectors-Wrapper.svg)

SolidWorks

Direct integrations with SolidWorks, SolidWorks PDM, and support for CATIA files.

[Learn more](https://www.colabsoftware.com/integrations/solidworks-add-in)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/660aa7febec017e773b39201/663101f03b0fed0f61a30990_Vectors-Wrapper.svg)

Teamcenter

Share part files directly from Teamcenter to CoLab. CoLab is also compatible with Siemens NX and Solid Edge.

[Learn more](https://www.colabsoftware.com/integrations/teamcenter)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/660aa7febec017e773b39201/663101f04461e679bd84057e_Windchill_logo-1.png)

Windchill

As official PTC partners, CoLab integrates with Windchill and supports Creo files. Push files to CoLab and see review and feedback information right from Windchill.

[Learn more](https://www.colabsoftware.com/integrations/windchill)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/660aa7febec017e773b39201/663101f1242bdc66dba7b860_Vectors-Wrapper.svg)

3DEXPERIENCE

Share files from Enovia Product Structure Explore to any CoLab workspace for review.

[Learn more](https://www.colabsoftware.com/integrations/3dx)

### CAD File Compatibility

It should be easy to share design files with the people you need feedback from—without compromising your IP security or downloading half a dozen CAD viewers. And with CoLab, it is easy. Securely push drawings or models to CoLab and set the appropriate permissions. Then use a simple link that lets anyone open and view files, right in their web browser.

![Share dashboard overview](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/66322959fb9270ce7f0040ed_image%20(3).webp)

![Comment example](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/663243e4e6ec6fb58f6f76da_PLM.webp)

### PLM

CoLab integrates directly with Windchill PLM, Solidworks PDM, Teamcenter PLM, and 3DEXPERIENCE. Using CoLab's PLM integrations, when you share a file for review, CoLab maintains critical associations between data objects in PLM/PDM.

[Learn more](https://www.colabsoftware.com/integrations/teamcenter)

### Jira

Turn design comments into Jira issues to make sure nothing slips through the cracks. Control which comments go to Jira, and synchronize issue status between both systems.

[Learn more](https://www.colabsoftware.com/integrations/jira)

![Activity overview](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/663243fc7ce3baf602790f7a_Jira.webp)

![Feedback dashboard](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/66324413c7d23c06dbca7926_API.webp)

### API

Don’t see the integration or compatibility you’re looking for here? CoLab’s API allows developers to build custom integrations that work with CoLab. Contact us to talk details.

[Learn more](https://www.colabsoftware.com/integrations/api)

## Key Security Features

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/6632254fe76b984021c20cda_Fast%20Deployment.svg)

### Fast Deployment

With a simple server side installation, integrate CoLab and PLM in 15-30 minutes

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/663225925926d4f7f9a8dcbc_User%20Provisioning.svg)

### User Provisioning

Supports user groups, user attributes, and integration with supplier management systems.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/663225d216cd1e9d19523ba9_Access%20Icon.svg)

### Access Controls

Configurable domain restrictions and integration with supplier identity provider.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/663224a888db562548e19945_Customer%20Support.svg)

### Dedicated Customer Support

Work with a dedicated onboarding project manager to get up and running in weeks.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/66322584b9517f8a8925be58_SSO%20Key.svg)

### Enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO)

Authorize access to CoLab directly from your existing identity provider/SSO solution, with support for **all** major identity providers.

## Better products start with better design conversations.

If you’re ready to see how CoLab can transform the way you work with suppliers, here’s how the process works.

‍

- **Every conversation starts with a discovery call.** During this call, a technical expert will understand your team’s challenges with design review today
- **Then, we’ll tailor a demo to address those challenges.** This demo includes you, of course, but also some key members from your team who can speak to your challenges in greater detail and vet CoLab as the solution.
- **Finally, we do a workshop with more members of your team.** This is the fun part! During this workshop, your team will each have temporary CoLab licenses and participate in a sample design review. You and your team will be guided through key features and use cases right inside the CoLab platform.
